calculation.description: Fade each asset's ten-session idiosyncratic move after removing the contemporaneous cross-asset mean return, with signal magnitude gated by lagged cross-asset dispersion relative to its 60-session baseline. All predictive inputs are lagged to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Full 15-asset cross-asset universe; broad historical period spanning multiple regimes. Recent 365-session IC/ICIR 0.069195/0.244090, recent 750-session 0.063289/0.223250, recent 1260-session 0.020984/0.072343. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
